title: CrevasseSeg: A Label-Efficient UAV Crevasse Segmentation Framework
abstract: arXiv:2608.15790v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Crevasse mapping from uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery matters for glaciological research and for field safety in glaciated terrain. Yet, pixel-level annotation of glacier surfaces is costly and requires domain experts. We introduce CrevasseSeg, a framework for binary segmentation over the terminus of Borebreen, Svalbard, comprising 1,938 unlabelled UAV orthomosaic tiles for self-supervised/unsupervised fine-tuning, 24 labelled tiles for validation and 176 labelled tiles for testing. Using CrevasseSeg, we benchmark five self-supervised objectives -- BYOL, a Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD) objective, Barlow-Twins, VICReg, and a combined BYOL-JSD objective -- across three architectures: O-Net, O-Net++, and a DINOv3-initialised O-Net. translated_title: CrevasseSeg：一种标签高效的无人机裂缝分割框架
translated_abstract: 摘要：从无人机（UAV）影像中绘制裂缝地图对冰川学研究和冰川地形的野外安全至关重要。然而，对冰川表面进行像素级标注成本高昂且需要领域专家。我们提出了CrevasseSeg，一个用于挪威斯瓦尔巴群岛Borebreen冰川末端的二值分割框架，包含1,938块未标注的无人机正射影像拼接瓦片用于自监督/无监督微调，24块标注瓦片用于验证，以及176块标注瓦片用于测试。利用CrevasseSeg，我们对五种自监督目标进行了基准测试——BYOL、Jensen-Shannon散度（JSD）目标、Barlow-Twins、VICReg以及组合的BYOL-JSD目标——并跨越三种架构：O-Net、O-Net++和DINOv3初始化的O-Net。每种配置在两种冻结特征读取器下评估，这两种读取器仅决策边界形式不同：线性探针和仅在24块标注验证集上拟合的非线性XGBoost分类器。
tldr: 本文提出CrevasseSeg框架，通过自监督学习在仅有24块标注数据的情况下，实现无人机影像中冰川裂缝的高效分割，显著降低标注成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CrevasseSeg, a framework that leverages self-supervised learning to achieve efficient crevasse segmentation from UAV imagery with only 24 labeled tiles, significantly reducing annotation costs.
